# Ajoy Chawla Appointed As Managing Director Of Titan Company

Nov 04, 2025  Dess Digital  Regulatory Updates

Ajoy Chawla Appointed As Managing Director Of Titan Company [...] Since October 2019, Chawla has led Titan’s Jewellery Division as CEO, overseeing a period of strong growth that saw the business triple its sales and profits, further cementing Titan’s leadership in the Indian jewellery market. Earlier in his career, he also contributed to the Watches Division, handling key functions in commercial, sales, retail, and supply chain management, and later leading accessories, licensed brands, and the Titan SBU.

hits.title: Titan announces senior management rejig; Ajoy Chawla ...
hits.snippet:
New Delhi, Tata group firm Titan Company Ltd on Friday announced top management changes with Ajoy Chawla set to become its Managing Director from January 1, 2026, succeeding incumbent C K Venkataraman.  
  
 Chawla is currently the CEO of the company's jewellery division, Titan Company said in a regulatory filing. [...] PTI

# Ajoy Chawla takes charge as Managing Director at Titan Company Limited

By Retail4Growth Bureau | January 13, 2026

After joining Titan in 1991, Ajoy Chawla has spent over three decades shaping key businesses and now leads the company as Managing Director. 

    

Ajoy Chawla takes charge as Managing Director at Titan Company Limited [...] Ajoy Chawla has stepped into the role of Managing Director at Titan Company Limited, marking a key leadership transition for the company.
